manage.lead: Reassure if stable; excise if new or changing in an adult.

points: Dermatology via the suspected cancer pathway; excision for histology.

items.t: New, enlarging or >1 cm blue lesion in an adult.

quiz.q: Why does a blue naevus look blue?
quiz.a: Deep dermal pigment scatters blue light (Tyndall effect).

quiz.q: Which dangerous lesion can look blue?

quiz.a: Over 1 cm (cellular blue naevus) or enlarging.
